results.note: Air Force first morning summary (Telegram t.me/s/kpszsu, repeated by Ukrinform 23 Nov 08:05 Kyiv): from 18:00 on 22 Nov Russia attacked with 153 strike UAVs (Shahed, 60 of them jet-powered, Gerbera, Parodiya), 134 shot down or suppressed.

second_opinion.note: Both models give the same figure of 153 from the Air Force summary.

results.note: Government Office results of 23 Nov: item 12, the government regulation issuing a price decree regulating fuel prices for 1-31 Dec 2026 (čj. 906/26), was approved; ČTK and an MF release of 23 Nov confirm maximum prices and the 2.50 CZK/l margin cap continue to the end of the year.

second_opinion.note: Both models cite the same approval of item 906/26 on 23 Nov.

results.note: VRT NWS, updated 23 Nov 14:17: later in the day police said 50,000 had taken part in the national demonstration in Brussels (organisers' figures not counted).

second_opinion.note: Both models cite the Brussels Times/Belga report of a police count of 50,000 (unions 70,000).

results.note: The Royal Palace statement of 23 Nov after De Wever's audience said the King encouraged the Prime Minister to continue his efforts to reach a budget agreement; no acceptance of the government's resignation was announced.

second_opinion.note: Both models read the same palace statement.

results.note: Bank of Israel interest-rate announcement of 23 Nov 2026: the Monetary Committee decided to keep the interest rate unchanged at 3.25 percent.
Econoday, released 23 Nov 2026: the November flash HCOB Eurozone Composite PMI is 51.7 (Actual column), unchanged from the October final; manufacturing 52.9, services 51.2.

second_opinion.note: Both models give 51.7 from Trading Economics.

results.note: Arianespace, 23 Nov: the VA271 countdown was interrupted by a technical event affecting the launcher's ground support systems and the launch was rescheduled to 24 Nov, when it succeeded, outside the window.

second_opinion.note: Both models report the slip to 24 Nov.

results.note: ČTK, 23 Nov 18:30: after the Monday republic assembly in Prague Kupka said the leadership feels support to continue and that no proposal to call an early congress was made; no leadership announcement or statutory written request was reported.

second_opinion.note: Both models find the assembly ended with no call for an early congress.

results.note: HPE press release of 23 Nov 2026 for the quarter ended 31 Oct: non-GAAP diluted net EPS $1.43 (GAAP $1.26), above the fixed $1.29 threshold; Earnings Whispers reports the same figure at 4:05 pm ET.

second_opinion.note: Both models cite the same $1.43 non-GAAP figure; the PDF was read after their pointer, hpe.com newsroom being unreachable.
